values.featuresTraits: Darkvision; Fey Ancestry; Researcher; Specialty: Alchemist; Arcane Recovery.
values.personalityTraits: Highly curious about the world and wants to explore every corner of it. Writes everything down in her precious notebook. Her parents worried that her curiosity would lead her into things she should not be involved in.
values.ideals: Knowledge: Everything I discover is a treasure worth keeping. Kindness: Help should be given to those who cannot take care of themselves; if I see someone in need, I find it hard to ignore.
values.bonds: My notebook is where I keep track of my adventures, discoveries, potions, and spells. It is where I can write everything I can think of. I would be devastated if I lost it.
values.flaws: Perhaps I'm too curious and get involved in things I shouldn't. I may also be too naive; I'm not stupid, just a bit too trusting.
values.notes: Female half-elf wizard, age 20, 170 cm, 60 kg. Raised on a small farm by a human father and elven mother. Sheltered because of concern over prejudice about her mixed heritage. Encouraged by her aunt to leave home and explore the world. Taught herbs, spellcraft, and alchemy by her mother and aunt. Trained by her father to defend herself with daggers and her fists. Her father's dagger is one of her most treasured possessions. 1st-level spell slots: 2.
